verdict.rationale: Trello offers building blocks that could approximate cross-team dependency tracking: linking cards, mirroring cards across boards, viewing Jira work inside a Trello list, and marketing that mentions cross-team collaboration. Nothing in the evidence describes dedicated dependency relationships such as blocks/blocked-by, so PMs would have to piece it together manually. Missing for 10: explicit dependency/blocker relationships between cards, cross-board dependency visualization (timeline or Gantt with dependencies), portfolio or launch-level rollup views, critical-path or slippage alerts, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of using Trello for multi-team launch coordination.
